LESSON: ENTERPRISE PROJECTS ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social
Topic 2.2: Enterprise projects environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Enterprise projects environment. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Enterprise projects environment
2. Give Kenyan examples for Enterprise projects environment
3. Practise Enterprise projects environment at school and at home
